name: ai.rivalize/rivalize-mcp
title: Rivalize
description: Competitive intelligence for agents: competitor teardowns, pricing, ads, reviews and momentum.

environmentVariables.name: RIVALIZE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Rivalize API key (rk_live_...). Create one at rivalize.ai under Settings, API Keys. Free plans get rate-limited reads.

environmentVariables.name: RIVALIZE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the Rivalize API that issued your key. Leave unset for rivalize.ai.

environmentVariables.name: RIVALIZE_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1, true or yes to register add_competitor, which spends credits. Read-only when unset.
